name: Bun v1.4
body: To install Bun v1.4 ```bash curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash # or you can use npm # npm install -g bun ``` Windows: ```bash powershell -c "irm bun.com/install.ps1|iex" ``` To upgrade to Bun v1.4.0: ```bash bun upgrade ``` Read the [blog post](https://bun.com/1.4): ### Thank you Bun is free, open source, and MIT-licensed.
